## Actor Descriptions

| Actor | 說明 |
|-------|------|
| ERP IT Admin | 系統管理員，可管理全組織所有 Token，包括撤銷任意使用者的 Token、檢視審計日誌（US-AUDIT-001）|
| ERP Business User | 一般 ERP 使用者，可自助建立、撤銷、更新自己 Token 的描述 |
| N8N Operator | 自動化工作流操作員，透過 Bearer Token 呼叫 Demo API（`/api/v1/demo/*`）|
| System Administrator | 系統運維，負責 Feature Flags 切換等運維操作 |

## Use Case Descriptions

| UC-ID | Use Case | 主要 Actor | 對應 User Story |
|-------|----------|-----------|-----------------|
| UC-01 | View My Token List | ERP User, IT Admin | US-AUTH-002 / AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-5 |
| UC-02 | Create API Token | ERP User, IT Admin | US-AUTH-001 / AC-1~6 |
| UC-03 | View Token Details | ERP User, IT Admin | US-AUTH-002 / AC-1, AC-2 |
| UC-04 | Revoke API Token | ERP User, IT Admin | US-AUTH-003 / AC-1~6 |
| UC-05 | Authenticate via Bearer Token | N8N | US-AUTH-004 / AC-1~9 |
| UC-06 | Call POC Sales API | N8N | US-DEMO-001 / AC-1~5 |
| UC-07 | Call POC Inventory API | N8N | US-DEMO-002 / AC-1~4 |
| UC-08 | Call POC Order Status API | N8N | US-DEMO-003 / AC-1~3 |
| UC-09 | View Audit Log | IT Admin | US-AUDIT-001 / AC-1~5 |
| UC-10 | Toggle Feature Flags | System Administrator | — (operational) |
| UC-11 | View All Users' Tokens | IT Admin | US-AUTH-002 admin variant（?userId= 過濾）|
| UC-12 | Update Token Description | ERP User, IT Admin | US-AUTH-005 / AC-1~6（GDPR Right to Rectification）|

## API Path Reference (with §4.1 EDD alignment)

| UC | API Path | Method |
|----|---------|--------|
| UC-02 | `/api/v1/me/tokens` | POST |
| UC-04 | `/api/v1/me/tokens/{tokenId}` | DELETE |
| UC-12 | `/api/v1/me/tokens/{tokenId}` | PATCH |
| UC-06 | `/api/v1/demo/sales` | GET |
| UC-07 | `/api/v1/demo/inventory` | GET |
| UC-08 | `/api/v1/demo/orders/{orderId}` | GET |
| UC-09 | `/api/v1/admin/audit-logs` (+ `/ApiTokens/AuditLog` UI) | GET |
| UC-11 | `/api/v1/admin/users/{userId}/tokens` | GET |
